scripts.check:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler types --include-runtime false --check
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.preview:cloudflare:production: npm run build:cloudflare:production && wrangler --config wrangler.production.jsonc dev
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:production:dry-run: npm run build:cloudflare:production && wrangler --config wrangler.production.jsonc deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:production: npm run build:cloudflare:production && wrangler --config wrangler.production.jsonc deploy
